dedupe_keys.name: attest project test networks and load profiles

description: The ATTEST test networks are 43 data sets of electricity transmission and distribution test systems with load, generation and flexibility profiles, prepared under the ATTEST project financed by the European Commission (grant 864298) and published in the INESC TEC research data repository. They include the full anonymised Portuguese transmission network for 2040 and 2050 under two scenarios (312 nodes, 8 interconnections with Spain), parts of the Croatian transmission system, a simplified UK transmission system for 2020 (30 nodes, 400 and 275 kV), anonymised real Portuguese distribution networks, synthetic Spanish urban distribution networks built with a Reference Network Model, and synthetic UK distribution networks for flexibility studies. Load data come as 15-minute profiles for 12 typical days. Each data set is a ZIP with a MATPOWER network file and auxiliary files, under CC-BY-SA or CC-BY at no cost, readable with MATLAB and MATPOWER or PYPOWER. Caveats: topologies are anonymised or synthetic with realistic assumptions for unknown data, so they are test systems, not real grids, and the repository entries were last updated in 2024. Simulation uses are power flow, flexibility and optimisation studies and planning scenarios. Related records: the MATPOWER format used for all network files is documented in model-matpower.
licence: CC-BY-SA (most data sets); CC-BY for some UK data sets
